body:
WHAT
CronList prints every scheduled cron job and wakeup for the session, one per line: id, flags (recurring/one-shot, durable/session), the schedule (cron expression, or 'at <ISO time>' for a wakeup) and the prompt. With nothing scheduled it says 'No scheduled jobs.'

WHY
Without it neither the agent nor the user can see what is pending, so stale or duplicate schedules would accumulate unnoticed.

WHERE
engine/tools/src/cron.ts — cronListTool (empty listSchema, execute() maps cron.list() entries, using j.source === 'wakeup' && j.fireAt for the 'at ...' form). engine/core/src/scheduling/cron.ts — CronScheduler.list() (strip() removes internal fields).

TEST CHECKLIST
1. With an empty CronScheduler, execute CronList; assert content is exactly 'No scheduled jobs.'.
2. Create one recurring cron job and one wakeup; execute CronList; assert two lines, the cron line contains '[recurring, session] cron "<expr>" -> <prompt>' and the wakeup line contains '[one-shot, session] at <ISO>' with the wakeup's fireAt.
3. Create a job with durable:true; assert its line contains 'durable' instead of 'session'.
4. Create three jobs; assert every id from cron.list() appears in the content.
5. Execute against a session with cron undefined; assert isError:true and the NO_CRON message.
